description:
Create a paper-trading exchange with a simulated balance. No API keys required. Paper exchanges let agents test strategies, deploy bots, and place trades without risking real money. Recommended starting point for first-time users and any scope=mcp:paper workflow.

Requires OAuth scope mcp:paper or mcp:live. Session-cookie users (dashboard) can always call this.

accountLabel.description: Friendly name shown in dashboard and bot configs, e.g. "BTC Paper Test". Defaults to platform name.

initialBalanceUsdt.description: Simulated starting balance in USDT. Defaults to 10,000.

platform.description: Exchange slug, e.g. "binance", "bybit", "okx", "hyperliquid". Use list_exchanges or the web docs for supported options.

name: create_paper_exchange
